title: White Bean and Ham Soup
steps:
Cook onion, celery
and carrots in olive oil,
6 minutes

Ham, garlic, herbs: 2 min.
Then beans, broth
and 2 cups water

Simmer 20 minutes.
Mash a cup of beans
to thicken
vo: Put the holiday ham in the freezer? Thaw some and make soup for six.
You need diced cooked ham, three cans of cannellini beans, half an onion, celery, carrots, chicken broth, garlic, rosemary and thyme.
Cook the diced onion, celery and carrots in olive oil for six minutes.
Add the ham, garlic and herbs for two minutes, then the drained beans, the broth and two cups of water.
Simmer twenty minutes, and mash about a cup of beans against the pot to thicken it. Serve it with cornbread.
